The two conforming edits to Article XIII are necessary, not cosmetic: without the carve-out from "UNDER NO CIRCUMSTANCE SHALL LICENSOR BE LIABLE ... INFRINGEMENT" the new indemnity would be internally contradicted, and without the carve-out from the one-half-of-amounts-paid aggregate cap the 3× super-cap element could not operate.
